auditDescription: The hourly check of the server: firewall, SSH, certificates, permissions and services. No secrets.
ownerDescription: What has to be true before Helena is reachable from the internet.
edgeDescription: Cloudflare Access in front of helena.volition.one. Helena checks every request from the tunnel again itself.
noReport: No audit report yet. Run once on the server:
stale: The report is more than a day old

check.net_firewall: Firewall lets only SSH, web and Syncthing in from the home network
check.net_self_guard: Processes on the server cannot pose as the owner
check.net_loopback_acl: Browser control, code and terminal reachable only by their services
check.net_local_owner: LAN sign-in never applies to loopback or the server itself
check.net_syncthing_nat: Syncthing opens no ports on the router
check.ssh_password: SSH with keys only, no passwords
check.ssh_options: SSH without agent forwarding, with few attempts
check.web_https: HTTPS with a valid certificate on the home network
check.web_tunnel_entry: Tunnel entry without LAN sign-in and with the edge check
check.web_leftovers: No development leftovers or readable backup copies in nginx
check.tunnel_service: Cloudflare tunnel runs sandboxed and without self-update
check.tunnel_edge: Cloudflare Access is configured in Helena
check.tunnel_acl: Only the tunnel reaches the tunnel entry
check.tls_certificate: Certificate valid for more than 14 days
check.auth_second_factor: Owner has a second factor (TOTP or passkey)
check.auth_step_up: Terminal asks for a code when it opens
check.sys_shells: Service accounts without a login shell
check.files_backups: Database dumps readable only by their service
check.files_secrets: Secrets and keys not readable by others

owner.stepUpOn: Terminal asks for a code when it opens
owner.stepUpOff: Terminal opens on the LAN without a code
owner.sessions: {count, plural, one {# open session} other {# open sessions}}

edge.configured: Set up: requests from the tunnel are checked
edge.notConfigured: Not set up: the tunnel entry refuses everything
edge.teamDomainHint: From Cloudflare Zero Trust → Settings, ends in .cloudflareaccess.com.
edge.audiencesHint: The AUD tag of the Access application for helena.volition.one, 64 characters. One per line.
edge.allowedEmailsHint: Optional: only these email addresses, even if the Access policy admits more. One per line.
